Class ZstdCodec

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.codec.transform.compress.CompressionStreamCodec
org.jwcarman.codec.zstd.ZstdCodec
All Implemented Interfaces:
Codec<byte[]>
public class ZstdCodec extends CompressionStreamCodec
Zstandard (RFC 8878) compression as a Codec<byte[]> transform, for use with Codec.andThen. Faster than gzip at every level and smaller at most, which makes it the usual choice for cache entries and queue payloads.

Backed by zstd-jni, which ships native libraries for the common platforms; that is why this transform lives in its own module rather than codec-core.

Like the built-in compression transforms, decoding is capped: a payload that would expand beyond the configured maximum is rejected before it is fully inflated, which defends against decompression bombs. The default cap is 64 MiB.

Instances are immutable and thread-safe.

    • ZstdCodec

      public ZstdCodec(int level)
      Creates a codec at the given compression level with the default decoded cap.
      Parameters:
      level - the compression level, within Zstd.minCompressionLevel() and Zstd.maxCompressionLevel(); higher is smaller and slower
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the level is outside the library's supported range

    • ZstdCodec

      public ZstdCodec(int level, long maxDecodedSize)
      Creates a codec at the given compression level and decoded-size cap.
      Parameters:
      level - the compression level, within Zstd.minCompressionLevel() and Zstd.maxCompressionLevel(); higher is smaller and slower
      maxDecodedSize - the maximum number of bytes a payload may decode to; must be positive
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the level is outside the library's supported range or the cap is not positive
